messages.text: Feel better soon Chris and Dakota! I feel fine right now but I was around Dakota Thursday, so I'm skipping the party and keeping my distance. Will tell you if anything changes.

I'll sleep in, still go to the game since it's outdoors, then skip the crowded party and Taper hangout to be careful. I'll stay honest and tell friends I feel fine but am keeping distance.
